data.title: Strategy (MSTR) On Bitcoin Buying And MSCI Exit Still Looks Undervalued
data.description: Strategy (MSTR) is back in focus after a special call on November 12, set against fresh disclosures on its Bitcoin buying, preferred share buybacks, and upcoming removal from key MSCI indexes. The recent 1-day share price return of Strategy shows a decline of 6.4%, capping a 7-day fall of 26.2% and a 30-day slide of 33.6%, which lines up with headlines around fresh Bitcoin purchases, MSCI index removal, and preferred share buybacks.
